long_description:
HOUSTON, DIWALI ON THE PATIO 🪔✨

The fits are coming OUT, the whole crew is pulling up, and we’re taking over the BAUHAUS patio for one of our favourite nights of the year 🥹💗

This November, celebrate NAZAARA Diwali under the lights with Bollywood, throwbacks, club bangers and a dance floor that we already know is going to be FULL 🙂‍↔️

Behind the decks, NAWAB & BAADBOY are bringing the energy all night long, from the songs we grew up on to the records that have the entire room singing along by midnight 🔊

Houston, get the Diwali fits ready and come celebrate with us 🪔✨

✨ Dress Code: Traditional South Asian Attire.

🪔 NAZAARA DIWALI 

💥 Saturday, November 7 

🪔 Bauhaus Houston Patio 

💥 NAWAB • BAADBOY 

🪔 Bollywood • Throwbacks • Club Bangers
